verdict.rationale: x402 Bazaar is a documented, publicly accessible discovery catalog (23,000+ resources) with search/filter APIs, an OpenAPI client, and an MCP server so agents can discover payable services via tool calls; listing is automatic and requires no API key. Community evidence corroborates real-world server/gateway operators using x402 in production. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of the Bazaar's discovery quality/scale claims beyond vendor docs.
